title: Release
summary: Gates and evidence behind one ship or hold call.

facets.label: How checked
facets.hint: The command, job, or procedure that ran.

facets.label: Result
facets.hint: The outcome against what was expected, with numbers.

facets.label: Evidence
facets.hint: A link, log excerpt, or artifact name.

facets.label: Risk
facets.hint: What shipping without this gate would mean.

facets.label: Note
facets.hint: Anything the release owner must know that fits nowhere else.

sections.title: What ships
sections.hint: The changes in this release and who they reach.

sections.title: Gates
sections.hint: Every gate, failed and pending first.

sections.title: Rollback
sections.hint: What triggers a rollback, and the exact steps.

options.label: Ship
options.summary: Release now, with any waivers noted.

options.label: Hold
options.summary: Wait until the gates that did not pass are settled.

decision.title: How to decide
decision.markdown: Choose ship or hold, then waive or rerun any gate that did not pass.
decision.example: ship, waive 6. Notes: 6: known arm64 flake.
